unlocks.title: Repeat Offender
unlocks.joke: Your own rules have refused you five times.
unlocks.when: cloud: the fifth refusal by one of the student's own assignments

unlocks.title: Portal Cowboy
unlocks.joke: Three clicks of drift. Git is keeping score.

unlocks.title: Who Has the Lock?
unlocks.joke: The pipeline and you, on one state, at once.

unlocks.title: Nothing to See Here
unlocks.joke: A clean plan on the first check.
